children: India's palm oil imports in August rose 7% from July to 782,761 metric tons, the Solvent Extractors' Association of India (SEA) said on Tuesday.
Imports of soyoil rose 26% to 628,736 tons and sunflower oil imports decreased 36% to 160,639 tons, the industry trade body said.
